title: Domestic Building Energy Ratings by dwelling type, renewable energy source, year of construction, heating fuel and NUTS3 region (EBQ02)
used_for: Also closes I-011. Census records heating FUEL, so a heat pump and direct electric resistance heating are the same row ('Electricity') - yet their COP differs by a factor of three or more and dominates the heating load (design 5.7). EBQ02 reports heat-pump and solar-panel penetration for the South-West NUTS3 region, which is Cork (IE053, confirmed from the OSi small-area attributes), so the split within electrically-heated homes comes from real regional data. Also supplies the PV and heat-pump adoption base rates for D04 at t0 (5.9 DER row).
